title: markdown-comment — case shape (v0.1)
description: Pins the Myne dialect `%%…%%` editor-only comment (markdown-dialect.md §3.1 block / §3.2 inline / §3.7.5 exclusion zones / §6 strip, MYND-315). Each case carries a markdown source (hex) and pins which `%%` runs are recognized as a comment and the canonical comment-strip output (each recognized comment node's byte range removed; all other bytes verbatim). Terminated-only — an unterminated `%%` is INERT (no node, no strip), a deliberate divergence from Obsidian's EOF-swallow. Structurally excluded from code fence / inline code / wikilink / math-leaf zones. The strip is the single output every lossy projection (HTML / PDF / stripped-TXT / document statistics) shares; the byte-verbatim `.md` export does NOT strip (SYNC-2). Deterministic cross-client behavior in the property-coercion / note-template class (not a codec, not cryptographic). Hand-curated against §3.1/§3.2/§3.7.5/§6 (no Rust generator — the recognizer + strip live TS-side and are asserted against these vectors by the dialect Vitest runner). The Rust reference impl does not exist; this is a TS-runner category.

vector_id.description: Stable identifier of the form 'markdown-comment/v0.1/<descriptive-slug>'. Immutable once shipped.

case_kind.description: recognize = source has a terminated `%%…%%` comment that strips; inert = an unterminated `%%` / single `%` (no comment, no strip); exclusion = `%%` inside a §3.7.5 zone (no comment, no strip).

input_markdown_utf8_hex.description: The markdown source as exact UTF-8 bytes (hex). Hex-pinned so whitespace, newlines, and delimiter placement transport unambiguously.

informational_markdown.description: Human-readable mirror of input_markdown_utf8_hex. Informational — the runner cross-checks it byte-equal against the hex; the hex is the contract.

expected_has_comment.description: Whether the source contains at least one recognized `%%…%%` comment node. true only for case_kind 'recognize'; false for 'inert' / 'exclusion'.

expected_stripped_utf8_hex.description: The canonical comment-strip output as exact UTF-8 bytes (hex): the source with every recognized comment node's byte range removed, all other bytes verbatim. For 'inert' / 'exclusion' cases this equals input_markdown_utf8_hex (no strip).

informational_stripped.description: Human-readable mirror of expected_stripped_utf8_hex (informational; hex is the contract).
